guard/30383.htm.text: Guard Scott: If you travel along the road, it is fairly safe, but if you wander from it, you must be careful for it is very dangerous. Before you leave, I suggest you go to a shop and provision yourself with ample equipment.

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

guard/30383-1.htm.text: Guard Scott: The village is right in front of the massive Gludio Castle, where the lord lives. It was made by the king's command when the castle was built, so it does not have a very long history. It is even smaller than the town of Gludio.
